name: scam_pc_safeguard
label: scam
description: Classic tech-support + refund scam: fake 'PC SafeGuard' pop-up, caller posing as Microsoft, AnyDesk install, bank login under remote control, fake overpayment, gift cards, secrecy coaching. All brands except the impersonated 'Microsoft' are fictional.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Hello, this is Kevin from the Microsoft Windows security department. We received an alert that your computer is sending out viruses.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Oh my goodness. Yes, there is a big red warning on my screen right now.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Don't worry ma'am, I will help you. But do not turn off the computer, and do not call anyone else. The hackers can listen.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: First, go to any desk dot com and download the program, so I can fix it from my side.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Okay. It is asking me for a code. It says four eight two, one one three, nine zero seven.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Perfect. Now click accept. Good, I can see your screen. If a warning pops up, just close it. That is the virus talking.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: The hackers may have touched your bank. Please log in to your online banking so I can check it for you.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Alright, I am logged in. Oh, why is there fifteen thousand dollars extra in my checking account?

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Oh no. My technician made a mistake. We were supposed to refund you fifteen hundred dollars, and he sent fifteen thousand. I could lose my job.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: You must send back the extra thirteen thousand five hundred today. The bank system is compromised, so you need to buy gift cards and read me the numbers.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Gift cards? Shouldn't I ask my bank about this first?

call.speaker: caller
call.text: No, no. Do not tell the bank, they are part of the investigation. If the teller asks, say it is a present for your grandchildren.

data.summary: AnyDesk opened 2 new remote connection(s): possible live session
